interactions.notes: No clinically significant interaction. Combination is commonly used.
Both may affect renal function. Monitor eGFR closely.

warnings: SGLT2 inhibitors may cause further decline in eGFR in patients with pre-existing renal impairment
Risk of diabetic ketoacidosis is elevated in patients with eGFR < 60
Monitor renal function at baseline, 3 months, and every 6 months thereafter
